name: Craftdesk Theme
description: A refined pixel-workbench theme for PI-Desktop: BoutiqueBitmap 9x9 UI type, JetBrains Mono for code, a quiet drafting grid, charcoal navigation, and restrained grass-green state color.

en.name: Craftdesk Theme
en.description: BoutiqueBitmap pixel typography, JetBrains Mono code, a quiet drafting grid, charcoal navigation, and restrained green state color.
en.safetyNotes: CSS-only global theme with a local information panel. No network, file, clipboard, or agent access.
